author: peterthepeter; based on work by meldavy
name: Decaid MQTT Bridge
description: Publish complete Decaid telemetry and controls to MQTT with optional Home Assistant auto-discovery.

Host.label: MQTT broker address
Host.description: Hostname or IP address, without mqtt:// or a port. Leave empty to disable the bridge.

Port.label: Broker port
Port.description: MQTT broker port. 8883 for TLS, 1883 for plain TCP.

EnableTls.label: Encrypted connection (TLS)
EnableTls.description: Use TLS with certificate validation, normally on port 8883. Disable only for a trusted local broker using plain MQTT, normally on port 1883.

HaAutoDiscoveryEnable.label: Enable Home Assistant auto-discovery
HaAutoDiscoveryEnable.description: Publish retained Home Assistant discovery entities. Disable and save before changing brokers or uninstalling.

HaDeviceName.label: Home Assistant device name (optional)
HaDeviceName.description: Leave empty to use the connected machine model automatically.

HeartbeatSeconds.label: Status heartbeat (seconds)
HeartbeatSeconds.description: Recommended: 60 seconds. Leave empty to use 60 seconds or your existing legacy interval. Wake and connection changes are immediate; measurement updates follow machine activity automatically. Minimum: 1 second. Overrides the legacy interval below when set.

TopicPrefix.label: Advanced: MQTT topic prefix
TopicPrefix.description: Normally leave unchanged. Empty uses de1plus/<unique id>. Changing this affects MQTT automations; disable discovery and save before changing it.

HaDiscoveryPrefix.label: Advanced: Home Assistant discovery prefix
HaDiscoveryPrefix.description: Normally leave homeassistant unchanged. Must match Home Assistant's MQTT discovery prefix.

HaEntityNamePrefix.label: Advanced: Home Assistant entity name prefix
HaEntityNamePrefix.description: Normally leave DE1+ unchanged. Optional prefix for entity display names, useful with multiple machines.

ClientId.label: Advanced: MQTT client ID
ClientId.description: Normally leave empty for a stable, automatically generated ID. Kept for existing installations and brokers requiring a specific ID. Must be unique per client.

PublishIntervalMs.label: Advanced: legacy heartbeat (milliseconds)
PublishIntervalMs.description: Compatibility setting for existing installations. Prefer Status heartbeat (seconds) above. Used only when that field is empty; leave both empty for 60 seconds. Minimum: 1000 ms.
